observations: Two game consoles are shown standing vertically on a white surface.
The console on the right has a triple-layered design characteristic of a PS4 Pro.
The console on the left has a double-layered design, likely a PS4 Slim or original model.
The PS4 Pro unit is covered in significant dust and has visible surface scuffs and smudges.
The 'SONY' brand name is visible on the top edge of the Pro console.
The 'PS4' logo is visible on the side of the Pro console.
The background shows retail shelving filled with mobile phone boxes (iPhone, Samsung, etc.).
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE' and a bag with 'McSteve Online Gadget Store' are present.
No controllers, cables, or receipts are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and 1 show the triple-layer chassis and logos.
No controller is shown in either photo.
The console in photo 0 and 1 is very dusty and has multiple surface marks.
The rear of the console where warranty seals are located is not shown.
The receipt is mentioned but not shown.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and loading a physical game disc.

risks.risk: The controller may be missing, third-party, or have 'stick drift'.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front and back of the controller, and a video of it being used.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened for repair or cleaning.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the factory warranty seals on the back of the console.

risks.risk: Internal dust buildup causing loud fan noise or overheating.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a demanding game for 5 minutes to hear fan volume.

proof_requests: Photo of the controller(s) mentioned in the text.
Photo of the back of the console showing the ports and warranty seals.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a screen.
Clarification on why two different consoles are pictured when only one is described.
response.reason: The console is visibly dirty, which contradicts the 'neatly used' claim. Furthermore, the controller and receipt are missing from the photos, and two different console models are shown without explanation.
